title: Mushroom Cabinet Dream
description: A surreal painting features a large green wooden cabinet with glass doors displaying white dress silhouettes and hanging figures. A giant blue human eye with tears melting in blue and orange drips dominates the center, while oversized green and orange mushrooms with white spots grow around and on top of the cabinet. A small blue and orange bird perches on the cabinet's edge.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene with a large green wooden cabinet with glass doors containing white silhouette dresses and hanging dress forms. A giant realistic blue human eye with long lashes is melting in blue and orange drips from the center of the cabinet. Oversized green and orange spotted mushrooms grow around and on top of the cabinet. A small blue and orange bird perches on the top right corner. Dark background with faint grid and floating labels, ethereal smoke and bubbles, in a detailed illustrative painting style.
